metadata.division: DIVISION 4-7-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 4-7-1-1. Purpose of article.
content.summary: The purpose of this Article is to provide reasonable regulations for the appearance, location, type and maintenance of fences and walls to ensure the safety of residents and the high-quality character and appearance of the City.

faqs.a: The purpose of this Article is to provide reasonable regulations for the appearance, location, type and maintenance of fences and walls to ensure the safety of residents and the high-quality character and appearance of the City.
